candidates.name: OGC API - Processes Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Processes defines a RESTful interface for exposing and invoking computational processes.
Processes can ingest vector or coverage data and produce new datasets.
semantic_limits: Executing a standards-compliant process can transform data but does not improve unverified source accuracy, provenance or legal parcel identity by itself.

candidates.name: OGC API - Environmental Data Retrieval Standard
verified_facts: OGC EDR defines discovery and query operations for environmental data resources.
It supports standardized query patterns for retrieving subsets from underlying environmental data stores.
semantic_limits: An EDR response inherits the uncertainty, datum, survey date and quality of its underlying resource; the API query pattern is not a certificate of parcel elevation accuracy.
